mentions.name: Segtax
mentions.description: Segtax is a startup founded in the summer of 2024, focused on cost segregation, a niche accounting professional service. The builder started the company while still employed, was laid off from Meta in February 2025, and has since worked on it full-time. According to the builder, the company is close to automating the bulk of the cost segregation work.
mentions.author: joeaca04
